	district_level_requirement = {
        value = 5
        if = { limit = { has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active } value = 0 }
    }
	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_non_tribal = yes
		NOT = { rite = { rite_has_parameter = alcohol_forbidden_strict } }
	
            }
        }
    }

	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }

	show_disabled = yes

	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }

	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_1_cost

	province_government_modifier = {
		not_parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_agricultural_tax = millet_distillery_income_tier_1
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_agricultural_tax = millet_distillery_income_tier_1_tribal
	}



	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_millet
		amount = basic_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_agricultural_tax = millet_distillery_income_per_millet_need
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_agricultural_tax = millet_distillery_income_per_millet_need_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	on_complete = {

	}

	next_building = millet_distillery_2
	type_icon = "resource_buildings/distillery.dds"

	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_consumer_category_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_millet CATEGORY = trade_category_cereals }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_income_building_modifier = yes
		ai_resource_new_building_modifier = yes
	}
}

	}
}

				stationed_light_cavalry_maintenance_low_modifier = stationed_maa_need_maintenance_reduction
				stationed_light_cavalry_maintenance_high_modifier = stationed_maa_need_maintenance_reduction
				stationed_heavy_cavalry_maintenance_low_modifier = stationed_maa_need_maintenance_reduction
				stationed_heavy_cavalry_maintenance_high_modifier = stationed_maa_need_maintenance_reduction
			}

millet_brewery_1 = {

	construction_time = construction_time_6_months
	triggered_name = {
		trigger = {
			geographical_region = world_middle_east
		}
		reference = "boza_brewery_1"
	}
	triggered_name = {
		trigger = {
			geographical_region = world_europe_east
		}
		reference = "braga_brewery_1"
	}
	triggered_name = {
		trigger = {
			geographical_region = world_asia_east
		}
		reference = "jiu_brewery_1"
	}
	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		NOT = { rite = { rite_has_parameter = alcohol_forbidden_strict } }
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_1_cost
	province_government_modifier = {
		not_parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_agricultural_tax = millet_brewery_income_tier_1
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_agricultural_tax = millet_brewery_income_tier_1_tribal
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_millet
		amount = basic_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_beer_production_add = millet_brewery_beer_output_per_millet_need
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_agricultural_tax = millet_brewery_agricultural_tax_per_millet_need
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_agricultural_tax = millet_brewery_agricultural_tax_per_millet_need_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	on_complete = {
	}
	next_building = millet_brewery_2
	type_icon = "resource_buildings/breweries.dds"
	ai_value = {
